Haliç Konservatuvarı Tiyatro Yüksek Lisa: She completed a master’s degree in Theatre at Haliç Conservatory. She has worked as an actress in theatre, television, film and advertising for many years. In recent years, she has also been writing and staging her own plays, with a particular interest in comedy. Alongside acting, she works as a jazz dance instructor and jazz vocalist.
1985 yılında İzmir’de doğdu. Tiyatroya 1: Born in İzmir in 1985, he began working in theatre in 1998. In 2000, he helped found Tiyatro Kordelya with a group of friends. Together with the ensemble, he organised the first and second Karşıyaka Amateur Theatre Days.
2003–2005 yılları arasında Karşıyaka Mav: From 2003 to 2005, he taught creative drama and theatre at Karşıyaka Mavişehir İlköğretim Okulu. Following the dissolution of Tiyatro Kordelya in 2005, he helped establish Dönüşüm Atölyesi Oyuncuları. Between 2004 and 2008, he founded the theatre group at Dokuz Eylül University’s Torbalı Vocational School and worked there as an instructor and actor. From 2007 to 2013, he taught the theatre group at Karşıyaka Anadolu Lisesi.
2013–2015 yılları arasında İstanbul’da M: From 2013 to 2015, he continued his theatre work at Mekân Artı in Istanbul. Alongside acting, he took on directing, teaching and backstage roles, while also helping to manage the theatre venue. He further developed his musical skills, creating and implementing music designs for various stage productions. He worked with a range of theatre companies in Turkey and abroad.
2015 yılında İzmir’e ve Dönüşüm Atölyesi: In 2015, he returned to İzmir and Dönüşüm Atölyesi Oyuncuları. While continuing to teach at Karşıyaka Anadolu Lisesi, he also worked as an actor at İSEM İzmir Sanat Etkinlikleri Merkezi and Konak Municipality’s Tiyatro Konak.
2018–2019 sezonunda Dönüşüm Atölyesi Oyu: For Cambazın Cenazesi, which he staged with Dönüşüm Atölyesi Oyuncuları in the 2018–2019 season, he was nominated for Best Supporting Actor and Best Dramaturgy at the second Özdemir Nutku Theatre Awards. The same production earned him the Promising Theatre Award at the 19th Direklerarası Theatre Awards. During the 2018–2019 season, he also trained as a creative drama facilitator with the İzmir branch of Çağdaş Drama Derneği and began teaching drama at a private school.
2020 yılının Kasım ayında Berlin’e taşın: He moved to Berlin in November 2020. In the 2021–2022 season, he performed in Migraaaanten at Ballhaus Prinzenallee. He helped found Tiyatro Berlin in 2021 and appeared in several of its productions until 2024. In 2022, he undertook training in theatre pedagogy in Berlin.
2023–2025 yılları arasında Berliner Ense: From 2023 to 2025, he appeared in Ich habe die Nacht geträumt at the Berliner Ensemble. In 2023, he performed in Üftade at the Maxim Gorki Theater as part of the “Gezi Festival”.
Sanatsal çalışmalarını 2025 yılından iti: He has continued his artistic work with Theater Kompanie since 2025 and with Berlin Oyun Stüdyosu since 2026.
1998 yılından bu yana farklı tiyatro top: Since 1998, he has worked with various theatre companies as an actor, director and instructor, establishing theatre groups and staging productions at the institutions where he taught. His stage credits include Deli Aklı, Kör Padişah, Yuppi Hayat, Balkon, Kuşlar, Gişe and Cambazın Cenazesi.
Kamera önü çalışmalarından bazıları ise: His screen credits include the short films Emanet and Gece, the television series Cinayet and Beni Böyle Sev, and the feature films Sardunya and Açık Kapılar Ardında.
1998’den bu yana oyuncu, yönetmen ve eği: He has worked in theatre as an actor, director and instructor since 1998. After working in İzmir and Istanbul, he moved to Berlin in 2020, where he performed at Ballhaus Prinzenallee, the Berliner Ensemble and the Maxim Gorki Theater. Alongside his theatre work, he has appeared in film and television productions. He continues his artistic work with Theater Kompanie and Berlin Oyun Stüdyosu.
Yelda Gülsoy, doğaçlama tiyatro alanında: Yelda Gülsoy is a theatre artist and educator specialising in improvisational theatre. She has devoted herself to improv since 2011. In Turkey, she performed as a member of the YOTA improv ensemble. Alongside her stage performances, she leads improv workshops and creates bespoke shows for companies and institutions. In Berlin, she performs in Turkish and German with Notausgang Improtheater, Play and Work, F*Impro, 6 Frauen, Berlin Oyun Stüdyosu and 90+ Improv.
2014 yılında Selçuk Üniversitesi Sinema-:
After graduating from Selçuk University’s Film and Television Department in 2014, he wondered, “How can I become a better-qualified unemployed person?” So he enrolled in the Theatre Department at Müjdat Gezen Art Centre. When he graduated in 2016, he thought, “This isn’t going to work,” and emigrated to Germany.

He was convinced he could continue working in theatre and film there. It turned out things were not quite that simple. So he decided to study Child Development and get himself a secure profession. And he did.

Then he started turning the absurdity of it all into material for stand-up comedy. In improv and stand-up, he takes on the extroverts with his self-doubting, well-mannered persona. He delivers his jokes, peppered with pedagogical insights, with the authenticity of an actor like De Niro and the delicate touch of an apricot picker.
